ABC Industries Private Limited - Annual Compliance Documentation FY 2024-25

SECTION 1: FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND REPORTING

Financial Statements Preparation:
Our company has prepared comprehensive financial statements for the financial year 2024-25 including Balance Sheet, Statement of Profit and Loss, and Cash Flow Statement. All financial statements have been prepared as per Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013 and Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS). The financial statements were reviewed and approved by the Board of Directors in their meeting held on March 15, 2025.

The Balance Sheet shows total assets of ₹5.2 crores with shareholders' equity of ₹3.1 crores. The Profit and Loss Account reflects a net profit of ₹85 lakhs for the year. Cash Flow Statement prepared as per Ind AS-7 shows operating cash flows of ₹1.2 crores. Notes to accounts include all required disclosures as per regulatory requirements.

SECTION 2: STATUTORY AUDITOR APPOINTMENT AND COMPLIANCE

Auditor Appointment:
M/s Sharma & Associates, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No. 12345W) have been appointed as statutory auditors of the company for the financial year 2024-25. The auditor appointment was approved by the Board of Directors and subsequently ratified by shareholders at the AGM. The auditors have provided their consent letter and eligibility certificate.

Form ADT-1 for auditor appointment has been filed with ROC within the prescribed timeline. The auditors have completed their audit procedures and provided an unqualified audit opinion on the financial statements. Audit report includes management letter with recommendations for internal control improvements.

SECTION 3: ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING PROCEEDINGS

AGM Conduct:
The 15th Annual General Meeting of ABC Industries Private Limited was held on September 20, 2024, at the registered office. Notice for AGM was sent to all shareholders 21 days in advance as required under Section 101 of the Companies Act, 2013. The AGM had proper quorum with attendance of directors and shareholders.

During the AGM, the following resolutions were passed:
1. Adoption of audited financial statements for FY 2023-24
2. Appointment of statutory auditors for FY 2024-25
3. Declaration of dividend at 10% on paid-up share capital
4. Re-appointment of retiring directors

Minutes of the AGM were properly recorded, signed by the Chairman, and maintained in the statutory records. Attendance register was maintained with details of all attendees.

SECTION 4: ANNUAL RETURN FILING

MGT-7 Filing:
Form MGT-7 (Annual Return) for FY 2023-24 has been prepared with all prescribed particulars including company details, shareholding pattern, and director information. The annual return was filed with ROC within 60 days of AGM as required under Section 92 of the Companies Act, 2013.

The annual return includes updated details of:
- Registered office and business address
- Principal business activities
- Particulars of shareholding and shareholding pattern
- Details of directors and key managerial personnel
- Details of meetings held during the year

Filing was completed on November 15, 2024, within the statutory timeline, along with payment of prescribed fees.

SECTION 5: ROC FILINGS AND COMPLIANCE

AOC-4 Filing:
Form AOC-4 containing financial statements has been filed with ROC within 30 days of AGM. The filing includes audited Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Cash Flow Statement, Board Report, and Auditor Report as attachments. Digital signatures of directors and company secretary were affixed as required.

The Board Report includes all mandatory disclosures including:
- Director Responsibility Statement
- Conservation of energy and technology absorption
- Foreign exchange earnings and outgo
- Risk management and internal controls
- Corporate governance compliance

SECTION 6: KEY MANAGERIAL PERSONNEL

KMP Structure:
The company has appointed the following Key Managerial Personnel as required under Section 203:
- Mr. Rajesh Kumar - Managing Director (appointed on April 1, 2023)
- Ms. Priya Sharma - Chief Financial Officer (appointed on June 15, 2023)  
- Mr. Amit Gupta - Company Secretary (appointed on August 10, 2023)

All KMP appointments have been properly documented with board resolutions, consent letters, and Form DIR-12 filings where applicable. Employment contracts and service agreements are in place for all key managerial personnel with clearly defined roles and responsibilities.

SECTION 7: BOARD STRUCTURE AND GOVERNANCE

Board Composition:
The Board of Directors consists of 5 directors including 2 Independent Directors as required for the company category. The independent directors have provided annual declarations of independence and confirmations of meeting independence criteria as per Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013.

Board meetings were held quarterly with proper advance notice to all directors. During FY 2024-25, four board meetings were conducted on:
- May 15, 2024 (Annual results approval)
- August 20, 2024 (Q1 results and strategy review)  
- November 25, 2024 (Q2 results and interim dividend)
- February 18, 2025 (Q3 results and annual planning)

All meetings had requisite quorum and minutes were properly recorded and signed.

SECTION 8: DIRECTOR INTEREST DISCLOSURES

Interest Disclosure Framework:
A robust system is in place for directors to disclose their interests in contracts, arrangements, and transactions with the company. Directors provide disclosures at the first board meeting and whenever any new interest arises during the year.

Register of contracts and arrangements is maintained as per Section 184 requirements. All related party transactions are pre-approved by the board and disclosed in annual return and board report. Directors abstain from discussions and voting on matters where they have interests.

Annual compliance certificate is obtained from all directors confirming adherence to disclosure requirements and absence of conflicts of interest.

SECTION 9: COMPLIANCE MONITORING AND INTERNAL CONTROLS

Internal Systems:
The company has established comprehensive internal controls and risk management framework. Internal audit function reviews compliance with various regulatory requirements on periodic basis. Compliance calendar is maintained to track due dates for various statutory filings and requirements.

Monthly compliance reports are prepared and reviewed by management and board. Any deviations or delays are immediately addressed with corrective action plans. Regular training programs are conducted for employees on compliance matters and regulatory updates.

SECTION 10: ADDITIONAL REGULATORY COMPLIANCE

Other Compliances:
The company maintains compliance with various other applicable laws including:
- Income Tax Act, 1961 - Regular filing of returns and payment of advance tax
- Goods and Services Tax - Monthly/quarterly GST returns filed timely
- Provident Fund and ESI compliance for employees
- Labor law compliance including minimum wages and working conditions
- Environmental clearances and pollution control measures

Annual compliance audit is conducted by external consultants to ensure adherence to all applicable regulatory requirements. Action plans are developed to address any gaps identified during compliance reviews.

This comprehensive documentation demonstrates ABC Industries Private Limited's commitment to maintaining high standards of corporate governance and regulatory compliance in accordance with the Indian Companies Act, 2013 and related rules.
